Shop Heavy-Duty Truck Wheels

Alloy Truck Wheels & Rims

The complete Armoury Wheels range: forged alloy wheels for drive, steer, offset steer, bud steer and super single applications, in Euro/Jap, US, Trailer and Volvo fitments from 16" through to 22.5". Every wheel carries a five-year warranty, is corrosion resistant and meets Australian Standards and DOT certification.

Shop Drive Wheels

Alloy Drive Wheels For Australian Trucks

Drive wheels take the torque, so they take the punishment. Every Armoury drive wheel is a forged alloy wheel rated for Australian heavy vehicle loads, in Euro/Jap, US and trailer fitments from 16" through to 22.5". Most of the range is a dual-purpose drive and steer wheel, so one fitment can cover both axle positions on the same truck.

Shop Steer Wheels

Alloy Steer Wheels For Australian Trucks

The full Armoury steer axle range in one place, covering both offset steers and bud steers. Offset steers run a deeper dish for tyre clearance and a wider stance, while bud steers keep the traditional flat face. All are rated for steer axle loads up to 4,500kg.

Shop Offset Steers

9 Inch Offset Steer Wheels

Also known as 9 inch offsets. A deeper dish moves the face outboard for tyre clearance and a wider, squarer stance up front. Rated to 4,500kg max load, in 22.5" x 9.00" across US 10/285 and Euro/Jap 10/335 fitments.

Shop Bud Steers

9 Inch Bud Steer Wheels

Shop Super Single Wheels

Super Single Alloy Wheels

Run one wide wheel where you would otherwise run duals. Super singles cut unsprung weight, free up payload and simplify tyre management across drive and trailer positions. 22.5" x 11.75" and 22.5" x 12.25" in US, Euro/Jap and trailer fitments.
